newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 14.

text.p: -- Motorola Inc said it expects to post lower year-over-year semiconductor sales and orders for a few more quarters, although it sees the rate of decline decreasing. Motorola shares closed at 51-7/8 on Wednesday.
-- Coca-Cola Bottling Co Consolidated said its board has authorized a Dutch auction tender offer to purchase for cash up to 500,000 shares of its outstanding common stock. The stock closed at 42-1/4.

-- Sun Microsystems Inc shares rebounded in after-hours trading on Wednesday, rising 5/8 to 58-1/2. The stock had fallen 3-1/2 to 57-7/8 during the day after Sun slashed prices by up to 38 percent on certain desktop computers and workgroup servers. The company also said shareholders approved a two-for-one stock split.
-- PepsiCo Inc was down 3/8 at 31-5/8 in London overnight on worries about the company's progress in South America.
-- Tiffany & Co Inc reported third quarter earnings per share of $0.26, compared to $0.19 a year ago. The First Call estimate was for $0.24. The stock closed at 38-1/8.
